Norm.Introduction: Hi there. The name's Norm. Pleased to meet you.#$b#I'm not much for talking. I make food and sell it from my truck. Stop by when I'm open.
Norm.Gift.Love.Generic: Hey, this is great stuff! Thank you!$1
Norm.Gift.Dislike.Generic: Thanks, but I don't like this.$0
Norm.Gift.Hate.Generic: Don't go bringing me any more of these. Got it?$2
Norm.AcceptGift_OwnItem: Well, you got me. I do like my own cooking.$1
Norm.AcceptGift_CookingNeeds: Oh, thank you! This is a great gift! I'll put it to good use in my kitchen.$1
Norm.AcceptGift_BirchSap: Birch sap! Why, thank you very much! This will be perfect for my brewing operation.$1
Norm.AcceptGift_BirchSyrup: Mighty thoughtful of you to bring me birch syrup.$1#$b#I can't use cooked syrup in my birch beer recipe, but I can still enjoy a treat.$1
Norm.Dialogue.Tue.1: Beautiful little town you've got here.
Norm.Dialogue.Tue8.1: Well, if it ain't my favorite customer!$1#$b#I don't usually do this, but this is for you.{{gift}}
Norm.Dialogue.Tue8.2: Hi there, @. Good to see you.#$e#Nothing new to report, if I'm honest. How's the farm?
Norm.Dialogue.Tue8.3: Heh, thanks for stopping by. I knew I could count on you to need a snack.$1
Norm.Schedule.EarlyMorning.1: Not open yet. Come back at 8, okay?
Norm.Schedule.EarlyMorning.3: I'll be open soon enough. Just enjoying the morning.
Norm.Schedule.OnTheJob.1: Hey, this is a food service prep area! Keep out, please.
Norm.Schedule.OnTheJob.2: Whatever this is about, it can wait until after I close up.
Norm.Schedule.OnTheJob.3: Can't you see I'm working here?
Norm.Schedule.GoodNight: I'm heading out tonight. Catch a few winks in the cab and hit the road before dawn. See you next week, I hope.
Norm.Lacey.Gossip: You know, I see a lot of different kinds of folks, driving a food cart from place to place.#$b#But I ain't never seen a giant, walking, talking mouse before! Bit of a surprise, I tell ya what.#$b#Do you know her? She said she lives in the forest. Anyway, she bought five pretzels. She was real excited about it.
